outcome_to_claim.VALID-POSITIVE: at least one frozen policy satisfies both endpoint targets and the registered complete guard; source inference is reported separately
outcome_to_claim.VALID-MIXED: at least one frozen policy satisfies both endpoint targets, but none satisfies the registered complete guard
outcome_to_claim.VALID-NEGATIVE: no frozen policy satisfies both registered endpoint targets under this benchmark and budget; source inference is reported separately
outcome_to_claim.ASSUMPTION-LIMITED: registered source inference is not tested; learner endpoint and guard qualification remains separately reportable

same.frequency_semantics: physical endpoints use the installed ANDES 60-Hz base; the V4 controller slots remain on the protected legacy 50-Hz scale and are converted once by adapt_v4_observations_to_physical (slots 1..6 multiplied by 60/50) before any 60-Hz consumer

observation_contract.no_message_arm_runtime_input: identical 7-slot network input with slots 3..6 zeroed by the env adapter at every step
observation_contract.joint_critic_input: concatenated 4 x 7 observation rows plus 4 x 2 actions for every arm; training-only, never at runtime

scalar_td3.step_reward: sum over the four agents of the V4 per-agent rewards

cd_matd3.differential_cost: sum_k (z_d,k / sigma_f)^2 / 3 + sum_k (p_d,k / sigma_p)^2 / 3 with z_d = T_d (f - 60) and p_d = T_d P_es
cd_matd3.multiplier_update: after each episode: lambda = clip(lambda + 0.05 * (sum_t c_c(t) - 3.0), 0.0, 10.0)

learner_contract.scalar_td3_critic_scope: joint centralized critic over all four observation rows and actions; training-only
learner_contract.update_schedule: critic update every step after the buffer holds at least batch_size transitions; actor and target updates every policy_delay critic updates

training_contract.episode_schedule: episode e uses development_scenario_order[e mod 24]; 60 full cycles; identical for every arm and seed
training_contract.convergence_rule: fixed interaction budget, no early stopping; convergence diagnostics (episode returns, critic losses, lambda) are recorded but never used for selection
training_contract.invalid_run_condition: nonfinite critic loss or nonfinite action at any step marks the run invalid, which consumes the seed
training_contract.checkpoint_rule: final weights only for evaluation; weights snapshots saved every 240 episodes for provenance; no best-of selection
training_contract.evaluation_access: no evaluation-profile execution during training; evaluation runs only after all nine trainings complete

missing_run_rules.restart_condition: host-side crash signature only (process killed, memory exhaustion, WSL halt); a restart trains from scratch with the same seed
missing_run_rules.evaluation_retry: never; any missing or corrupt evaluation record is CANARY-INVALID

same.uncertainty: three-seed median plus seed-level table; descriptive, not population inference
same.evaluation_record_keys: profile_id, arm_id, training_seed (null for deterministic), scenario_id, steps, identity, initial_freq_hz_physical, checkpoint_sha256 (learning arms only)

fresh.fresh_profile_source: prospectively generated by r481_fresh_profiles.build_fresh_rows with seed 481; all R399/R401 viewed rows excluded
